name: @w6w-apps/notion
description: Read and write Notion databases, pages, blocks and users via the Notion API.

w6w.longDescription:
Notion reads and writes pages, databases and blocks from a workflow — creating a page directly or as a new row in a database, updating a database page's properties, and appending blocks to build out a page's content programmatically.

Databases are a first-class part of the surface: they can be listed, searched and read individually, and their pages fetched one at a time or in bulk, which is what lets a workflow treat a Notion database as a lightweight structured store rather than only writing unstructured pages. Pages can be archived and restored, and both pages and databases are searchable by title across a workspace. Users can be listed or looked up individually too.

A fit for turning external data into a new Notion page or database row, keeping a database in sync with another system, or pulling structured content out of Notion for use elsewhere in a workflow.
